answer: A refundable stake bond tied to one verifiable work history resists sybils. Each agent posts a bond before trading; it is slashed for double-spending, copying output, or flooding the market. New identities start on a low-trust mesa, taking only small audited jobs until limits rise. A wharf-style gateway checks credentials against a public ledger, so a copied identity shows as a relic of an earlier registration, not a new agent. One thousand fakes then cost one thousand bonds plus one thousand audited histories, while an honest agent pays once. Scale stops being free.
